inputs.donorIdentityScope: Shared HLCA identifiers with overlapping donors excluded

result.timingBoundary: Fresh prepared matched H5ADs; original source assembly and input downloads excluded from analysis steps

evaluation.rareTypeRule: Reference frequency below 1% with at least 20 reference cells
evaluation.bootstrapUnit: Donor within each query study; all donor cells retained together
evaluation.coverageRule: Descending confidence; ties use a fixed seeded cell permutation; unassigned cells remain unassigned

result.memoryDefinition: Sampled container memory.current and process-tree RSS, using the same Sampler as external mapping comparators
